own_solution.law: Archimedes' principle and vertical equilibrium give T = (rho_l - rho_s) g a^3. Converting a = 10 cm to 0.10 m gives T = (1000 - 600)(9.8)(0.001) = 3.92 N.
assumptions: The liquid is in hydrostatic equilibrium with uniform density.
The cube remains fully submerged and at rest.
The string pulls downward, and the cube experiences no additional contact force.
Lengths are converted to metres when evaluating the relations in SI units.

TCBBB.regime: The required equilibrium tension is below the breaking strength q: 3.92 N < q. All listed strengths, 30, 50 and 80 N, satisfy this condition.

T13C2.regime: The required equilibrium tension is below the breaking strength q: 3.92 N < q. All listed strengths, 30, 50 and 80 N, satisfy this condition.
